title: Miami Heat at Sacramento Kings odds, picks and predictions
text:
Heat at Kings odds, picks and predictions NFL MLB NBA NHL NCAA Football NCAA Basketball UFC/MMA PGA Tour Games NBA Miami Heat at Sacramento Kings odds, picks and predictions
 Nathan Beighle Sportsbook Wire Nov. 8, 2026, 11:48 a.m. ET The Miami Heat (3-6) and Sacramento Kings (1-8) meet Sunday from Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California. Tip is set for 9 p.m. ET. Let's analyze NBA odds around the Heat vs. Kings odds and make our expert NBA picks and predictions for the best bets.
 2025-26 season series: Tied 1-1 with each team winning on the road
 The Heat lost to the Golden State Warriors 120-100 Thursday, failing to cover as a 3.5-point road underdog with the Under (236.5) cashing. G Davion Mitchell led the team with 22 points on 9 of 18 shooting. Miami has traded off winning and losing over its last 4 games and is 1-3 against the spread (ATS) in that span. It is 2-7 ATS on the season.
 The Kings lost to the San Antonio Spurs 124-109 Friday, covering as a 17.5-point home underdog as the Over (231.5) hit. Sacramento was led by rookie G Darius Acuff Jr. , who scored 22 points and dished out 8 assists. The Kings are among the 3 teams in the Western Conference without multiple wins. They are 3-6 ATS.

 Heat at Kings picks and predictions
 Prediction
 Heat 118, Kings 110
 Moneyline 
 PASS .
 Avoid this play. The Heat (-450), despite being on the road, should come out on top with ease, but they are far too expensive to consider here.
 Against the spread 
 BET KINGS +10.5 (-115) .
 The Kings' defense has actually improved a bit as of late. They allowed 121 points or more in their first 6 games of the season, but have limited 2 of their last 3 opponents to 116 or fewer. Sacramento was 1-5 ATS to start the season and has improved there as well, going 2-1 ATS in its last 3 outings.
 The Heat, especially as a favorite, have struggled significantly. They are just 1-4 ATS when favored and have given up at least 113 points in every game this season. Expect those shortcomings to continue for Miami and back KINGS +10.5 (-115) .
 Over/Under 
 BET UNDER 237.5 (-110) .
 Both teams come into this one with slight Under trends. The Kings have gone south of the total in 2 of their last 3 games, scoring 115 points or fewer in each outing. The Heat are on their fourth game of their road trip out West and are 1-2 O/U in that span. They are 4-5 O/U on the season.
 Best prop bet
 Kings G DARIUS ACUFF JR. UNDER 23.5 POINTS (-110).
 Likely to be hounded by Mitchell, the rookie Acuff Jr. will have a tough time getting clean shots Sunday. He's gone Under this total in 2 straight games and is just 17 of 44 shooting in that span. His struggles should continue against Miami.
